No, we need currency conversion. There's no tool for currency conversion. We can approximate using known rates. But we should not use external API. We can give approximate conversion based on typical rates. But we might want to mention that rates fluctuate. Provide approximate conversion. Use approximate rate: 1 USD ~ 0.78 GBP (as of some date). So 20 USD ~ 15.6 GBP. Or we can say around £15.50. Provide note that it's approximate. Also ask if they want a more precise conversion. Provide answer.
